blocks.text: Blockchain mein data security ka matlab hai ke blockchain mein rakhi maloomat baghair ijazat rasai (unauthorized access), chhed chhaar (tampering) ya zaya hone se mehfooz rahe. Ise asaan banane ke liye rozmarra ki ek misal lete hain: daak (mail) se khat bhejna.
Sochiye aap dost ko aham maloomat wala khat bhejna chahte hain, aur chahte hain ke raste mein koi aur na use parh sake na badal sake.

items: Khat band karna (Encryption): bhejne se pehle aap khat aise khaas lifafe mein rakhte hain jo sirf aap ka dost khol sakta hai. Blockchain mein encryption aisa hi hai: data ko aise code mein badal diya jata hai jise sirf asal wusool karne wala (ya sahi key wala) samajh sake, jaisa Figure 6.5 mein dikhaya gaya hai.

Khat par dastakhat (Digital Signature): phir aap lifafe par apne khaas dastakhat karte hain. Dost aap ke dastakhat pehchanta hai, is liye use yaqeen hota hai ke khat aap hi ne bheja aur badla nahi gaya. Blockchain mein ise digital signature kehte hain, jo yaqeeni banata hai ke data asli (legitimate) bhejne wale se aaya aur us mein chhed chhaar nahi hui.

blocks.alt: Oopar Secret key, jis se do teer neeche do keys tak. Plain Text (XYZ) Encryption se Cipher Text (12ne) banta hai, jo Decryption se wapas Plain Text (XYZ) ban jata hai; dono qadmon mein wohi secret key lagti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.5: Cryptography blockchain mein data mehfooz rakhti hai (kitab ki Figure 6.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Plain text (asal paigham, jaise XYZ) secret key se encrypt ho kar cipher text (be-maani lagne wala code) ban jata hai. Wusool karne wala wahi key laga kar decrypt karta hai aur asal plain text wapas mil jata hai. Key ke baghair cipher text parha nahi ja sakta.

items: Bharosemand nizam se bhejna (Blockchain Network): aap koi bhi daak service istemal karne ki bajaye aisi bharosemand aur mehfooz service lete hain jo delivery ka har qadam record karti hai. Koi rasta badalne ya khat se chhed chhaar ki koshish kare to nizam pakar leta hai aur koshish radd ho jati hai. Blockchain network bhi aisa hai: har data ek block mein record hota hai aur us block mein koi tabdeeli network ko nazar aa jati hai.

Khat ki kai copies (Decentralization): khat gum na ho, is liye aap us ki copies mukhtalif bharosemand services se kai jagahon par bhejte hain. Ek khat gum bhi ho jaye to baqi pohanch jate hain. Blockchain mein ise decentralization kehte hain: data kai computers (nodes) par rakha jata hai, is liye ek node par hamla ho jaye tab bhi data mehfooz rehta hai.

blocks.text: Blockchain mein yeh kaise kaam karta hai

items: Encryption data ki hifazat karti hai, taake sirf ijazat wale use parh sakein.
Digital Signatures yaqeeni banate hain ke data badla nahi gaya aur bharosemand zariye se aaya hai.
Blockchain Network har kaam record karta hai, is liye data se chhed chhaar ki har koshish aasani se pakri jati hai.
Decentralization ka matlab hai data bohat si jagahon par rakha hai, is liye hackers ke liye hamla karna ya data badalna bohat mushkil hai.

blocks.text: In sab tareeqon ko mila kar blockchain data rakhne aur bhejne ka bohat mehfooz tareeqa deta hai, jis mein baghair ijazat logon ke liye maloomat tak pohanchna ya use badalna taqreeban na-mumkin hota hai.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Class Activity! Sochiye aap ke paas ek khufia code hai. Apne code mein dost ko paigham likhein aur dekhein ke kya woh use decode (hal) kar sakta hai.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Kya aap jaante hain? Amazon aur Microsoft jaisi bari companies apne taqatwar computers se blockchain networks chalane mein madad karti hain.

blocks.prompt: Class Activity ka namuna: khufia code mein paigham likhein. Is ka encryption se kya rishta hai?
blocks.explanation: Maslan har harf ko alphabet mein 3 qadam aage kar dein (A ki jagah D, B ki jagah E): HELLO ban jata hai KHOOR. Dost har harf 3 qadam peeche kar ke HELLO wapas pa leta hai. Yahan '3 qadam' hi key hai: key ke baghair sirf be-maani harf nazar aate hain. Yahi encryption ka khayal hai. (Is tareeqe ko Caesar cipher kehte hain; yeh aam ilm hai, kitab mein nahi.)

items: Khat ki misal: encryption (band lifafa), digital signature (dastakhat), blockchain network (har qadam record), decentralization (kai copies).
In sab se blockchain data ko baghair ijazat rasai aur chhed chhaar se bachata hai.
